summary: Viking Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results, including revenue of $2,190.5 million (up 16.5% YoY), Adjusted EBITDA of $748.4 million, and diluted EPS of $1.31. The filing also provides booking updates: 96% of 2026 and 53% of 2027 Capacity Passenger Cruise Days sold as of August 9, 2026. This is a routine earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, furnished under Rule 13a-16, not incorporated by reference. No special-situation transaction, corporate action, or strategic event is announced; the content is purely operational and financial performance reporting.
